skills.name: orchestrate
skills.title: Orchestrator
skills.description: Single entry point for the full bundle. Classifies your request and routes to the right skill — or chains multiple skills end-to-end via Full Pipeline Mode.

skills.name: search-lit
skills.title: Literature Search
skills.description: PubMed + Semantic Scholar + bioRxiv search with anti-hallucination citation verification. Token-efficient error handling.

skills.name: fulltext-retrieval
skills.title: Full-Text Retrieval
skills.description: Batch open-access PDF downloader. Unpaywall → PMC → OpenAlex → CrossRef pipeline. OA-only — no paywall bypass.

skills.name: check-reporting
skills.title: Reporting Guidelines
skills.description: Manuscript compliance audit against 33 reporting guidelines and risk-of-bias tools with item-by-item assessment and section boundary checks.
features: STROBE, STARD, STARD-AI, PRISMA, CONSORT, TRIPOD+AI, CARE, MI-CLEAR-LLM

skills.name: design-study
skills.title: Study Design
skills.description: Identifies analysis unit, cohort logic, data leakage risks, and validation strategy.

skills.name: analyze-stats
skills.title: Statistical Analysis
skills.description: Reproducible Python/R code for 13 analysis types including regression, propensity score, and repeated measures. Calibration mandatory for prediction models.

skills.name: make-figures
skills.title: Publication Figures
skills.description: Journal-spec figures and visual abstracts: ROC curves, forest plots, flow diagrams, Kaplan-Meier, and more.

skills.name: grant-builder
skills.title: Grant Proposals
skills.description: Structures significance, innovation, approach, milestones, and consortium roles.

skills.name: intake-project
skills.title: Project Intake
skills.description: Classifies new research projects, summarizes state, and recommends next steps.

skills.name: present-paper
skills.title: Paper Presentations
skills.description: Academic presentation prep: paper analysis, speaker scripts, slide note injection, Q&A.

skills.name: publish-skill
skills.title: Skill Publishing
skills.description: Convert personal Claude Code skills into distributable, open-source-ready packages.

skills.name: meta-analysis
skills.title: Meta-Analysis
skills.description: Full 8-phase systematic review and meta-analysis pipeline. DTA (bivariate/HSROC) and intervention MA with PRISMA-DTA compliance.

skills.name: write-paper
skills.title: Manuscript Writing
skills.description: Full 8-phase IMRAD pipeline from outline to submission-ready manuscript with built-in critic-fixer loops and section boundary enforcement.

skills.name: self-review
skills.title: Self-Review
skills.description: Pre-submission check across 10 categories with research-type branching (AI, observational, educational, meta-analysis, case report, surgical).

skills.name: revise
skills.title: Revision Response
skills.description: Parses reviewer decision letters, classifies comments as MAJOR/MINOR/REBUTTAL, and generates point-by-point responses.

skills.name: manage-project
skills.title: Project Management
skills.description: Scaffold research projects, track writing progress, generate submission checklists and backwards timelines.

skills.name: calc-sample-size
skills.title: Sample Size Calculator
skills.description: Interactive sample size calculator with decision-tree guided test selection. Covers 11 designs including Cox regression EPV.
features: DTA, t-test, ANOVA, chi-square, McNemar, survival

skills.name: clean-data
skills.title: Data Cleaning
skills.description: Standardize, validate, and transform raw research datasets. Handles missing data, outlier detection, and variable recoding.

skills.name: find-journal
skills.title: Journal Finder
skills.description: Match your manuscript to target journals by scope, impact factor, turnaround time, and open-access policy.

skills.name: write-protocol
skills.title: Protocol Writing
skills.description: Generate SPIRIT-compliant study protocols and PROSPERO registration drafts for systematic reviews.

skills.name: add-journal
skills.title: Add Journal Profile
skills.description: Add new journal profiles to the database. Extracts metadata from author guidelines and generates dual profiles (write-paper + find-journal) with quality gates.

skills.name: deidentify
skills.title: De-identification
skills.description: De-identify clinical research data before LLM-assisted analysis. Standalone Python CLI with 10 country locale packs. No LLM involved.

skills.name: find-cohort-gap
skills.title: Cohort Gap Finder
skills.description: Research gap finder for longitudinal cohort databases. 6-phase pipeline (cohort intake → PI profiling → intersection matrix → literature saturation scan → 6-Pattern scoring → feasibility gate) that outputs ranked topic proposals with comparison tables and one-pagers.
features: Works with any cohort: NHIS, UK Biobank, institutional EMR, health checkup registries

skills.name: replicate-study
skills.title: Study Replication
skills.description: Replicate an existing cohort study on a different database. Extracts methodology from a source paper, maps variables via harmonization table, generates analysis code, and produces a replication difference report.
features: 5-phase workflow: source analysis → variable mapping → code generation → difference report → verification

skills.name: cross-national
skills.title: Cross-National Comparison
skills.description: End-to-end cross-national comparison study using parallel survey data. Variable harmonization, parallel weighted analysis (no data pooling), and country-stratified comparison tables.
features: KNHANES + NHANES + CHNS variable coding references
Country-specific survey design with no data pooling

skills.name: batch-cohort
skills.title: Batch Cohort Analysis
skills.description: Generate N analysis scripts from one validated template × multiple exposure/outcome combinations. The "80-person team" pattern: same method, swap variables only.
features: Validated: 18 combos on KNHANES, 45 combos across 3 countries

skills.name: fill-protocol
skills.title: Protocol Form Filler
skills.description: Fill Korean IRB and institutional Word form templates (.doc/.docx) while preserving original layout, cell structure, and formatting. Extracts content from your protocol draft and maps it to labeled form cells.
features: Preserves original form structure — no layout breakage
Cell label matching for Korean IRB forms

skills.name: humanize
skills.title: AI Pattern Remover
skills.description: Detect and remove AI writing patterns from academic manuscripts. Scans for 18 common patterns — significance inflation, AI vocabulary, copula avoidance — and rewrites flagged passages while preserving technical accuracy.
features: Density target: <2.0 AI instances per 1,000 words
Rewrites preserve all numbers, p-values, and clinical terms

skills.name: author-strategy
skills.title: Author Strategy
skills.description: PubMed author profile analysis. Fetches publication history via E-utilities, classifies study types (GBD, SR/MA, NHIS, AI/ML, etc.), generates 7 visualizations, and produces a strategy report with replication opportunities.
features: Study type classifier: GBD, SR/MA, NHIS, AI/ML, cross-national, case series
Replication opportunity scoring with co-author gap analysis

skills.name: peer-review
skills.title: Peer Review Drafter
skills.description: Structured peer review drafting for medical imaging journals. Systematic manuscript analysis, journal-specific formatting (RYAI, INSI, EURE, AJR, KJR), conciseness targets (500–800 words), and pre-submission QC checklist.
features: Major / Minor / Reject recommendation with rationale
Journal-specific format presets for 5 radiology journals
Pre-submission QC: word count, tone, ethical red flags

skills.name: ma-scout
skills.title: MA Topic Scout
skills.description: Meta-analysis topic discovery and feasibility assessment. Two modes: Professor-first (profile → pillar analysis → MA gaps) or Topic-first (question → landscape scan → co-author matching). Multi-source validation with realistic k estimation.
features: Realistic k estimation with 15–30% registration discount

skills.name: lit-sync
skills.title: Literature Sync
skills.description: Sync research references from .bib files to Zotero library + Obsidian literature notes. Concept extraction from 10+ accumulated notes with cross-cutting theme discovery. Works after /search-lit or standalone.
features: Zotero import via Better BibTeX key matching
Obsidian literature note generation with wikilinks
